name: Takamine Nanako
source:
A naive girl who calls Kiyomi "Mitti".
Looks like carefree child with no hesitation in talking with strangers like Kenji, but indeed she is a frank rich girl who cares about her best friend Kiyomi.
She is interested in ecchi more than the sisters, so having relation with her once, allows continue it as one pleases?
